question:
The total surface area of a solid hemisphere is 942 cm². Its volume (in cm³) is closest to:

(Take π = 3.14)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Surface Area (TSA) of solid hemisphere = 3πr² = 942 cm²

⇒ πr² = 942 ÷ 3 = 314

⇒ 3.14 × r² = 314 ⇒ r² = 100 ⇒ r = 10 cm

Volume = (2/3)πr³ = (2/3) × 3.14 × 1000

Volume = 6280 ÷ 3 ≈ 2093.33 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 2093 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total Surface Area (TSA) = 942 cm²

π = 3.14

**Formula Used:**

TSA of solid hemisphere = 3πr²

Volume of hemisphere = (2/3)πr³

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a5f763c624c7c26213099eed222f6758982446464713f5473c1060911a2b8475.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 3 × 3.14 × r² = 942

⇒ 9.42 × r² = 942

⇒ r² = 942 ÷ 9.42

⇒ r² = 100

⇒ r = √100 = 10 cm

⇒ Volume = (2/3) × 3.14 × (10)³

⇒ Volume = (2 × 3.14 × 1000) ÷ 3

⇒ Volume = 6280 ÷ 3

⇒ Volume = 2093.333... cm³

Rounding to the closest integer:

⇒ Volume ≈ 2093 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 2093 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Curved Surface Area of Hemisphere

The surface area of the curved part of a hemisphere is 2πr².

Full Sphere Properties

For a full sphere of radius r: Total Surface Area = 4πr² and Volume = (4/3)πr³.

Ratio of TSA to Volume for Hemisphere

The ratio of TSA to Volume for a solid hemisphere is (3πr²) : ((2/3)πr³) = 9 : 2r.</p
